question: How can embracing others' wives be presented as worship of the supreme goddess?
premises: The practitioner performs an act of worship.
The supreme goddess is the designated object of worship.
inference: The acts of embracing and worship are directed toward honoring the supreme goddess.
uncertainties: Whether paradārān is meant literally or as a ritual-symbolic referent is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: Having embraced the wives of others and having worshipped, one honors the supreme goddess.
